requirement: When `output.html.git-repository-url` names a GitHub repository and `output.html.edit-url-template` uses that repository's `/edit/<branch>/{path}` form, each safely resolved source location displayed for an evidence input MUST link its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob/<branch>/<file>#L<start>-L<end>`. A source location MUST remain plain text when a safe URL cannot be derived. A generated detail page MUST use its evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when the file exists, or its requirement chapter when the evidence file is missing.
rationale: I found no gaps. Each obligation maps to marked code and has a test. **Obligations, code and tests** 1. **Link only when the repository is GitHub and the template is that repository's `/edit//{path}` form.** - `SourceLinks::from_config` (src/index.rs:46-86) reads both settings. It returns `None` unless the repository URL is `https://github.com//` with a safe character set. - It also returns `None` unless the edit template is exactly `{repository}/edit//{path}`. Otherwise it builds `blob_prefix = {repository}/blob/{branch}`. - Test `source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch` (src/index.rs:1493) checks a matching config, a template for a different repository (`None`), and a `javascript:` config (`None`). 2. **Each safely resolved source location links its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob//#L-L`.** - `render_input` calls `render_source_location` for every resolved range. - `render_source_location` calls `input_url` and emits `file:start–end`. - `input_url` and `encode_url_segment` build `blob_prefix/#L{start}-L{end}`. - The same test asserts the exact URL `.../blob/release/src/evidence.rs#L26-L37` and percent-encoding of `a b#c.rs`. It also asserts the rendered `` markup in a full detail page. 3. **A location stays plain text when no safe URL can be derived.** - `input_url` returns `None` for a zero start, an end before the start, parent-directory or absolute components, non-UTF-8 segments, and an empty path. - Without a `SourceLinks` value, `render_source_location` falls back to plain `` text. - Tests assert `None` for `../outside.rs` and for start 0. Test `detail_page_renders_markdown_and_highlighted_input_sections` (src/index.rs:1405) renders with `source_links: None` and asserts the plain `- src/main.rs:1–4` output. 4. **A detail page uses its evidence JSON as the edit target when the file exists, and its requirement chapter when the file is missing.** - `DetailPlan::populate` (src/index.rs:359) chooses `evidence_edit_path(&config.book.src, name)` when `evidence_path.exists()`, and `definition.path` otherwise. It sets `page.source_path` to that choice. - `evidence_edit_path` builds `../…/evidence/.json` relative to the book source directory. - Test `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts `../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json` for an existing record and `requirements/core.md` for the absent one. The source-links test also asserts `evidence_edit_path` for a nested `docs/md` source directory. **Marking and unspecified behavior** - All the implementing items carry `{impl}` references, and both tests carry `{test}` references. - The `{impl}` on the block in `preprocess_book` (src/lib.rs) is an extra reference, not a missing one. It is not a gap under the task's rules. - I found no unspecified observable behavior. The owner and project character checks fall under "safely resolved".
